steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow specified by the case.
Change the initial event type to RFQ.
Apply an RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER product with the requested quantity.
Confirm the event contains one line item.
Confirm the RFQ sheet rendered the columns required by the case.

args.goal: On the RFQ product sheet, select CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB so Product Variant shows Default Variant, set Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), open Savings, choose Last Purchase Price for the product, save it, and stop on the create screen showing the saved savings basis.

steps.note: Perform and verify the product-specific selections and Last Purchase Price savings configuration not covered by a dedicated domain step.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Invite a QA vendor so the event can be published and receive a bid.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Submit a vendor bid so savings can be calculated after bidding.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Close the bidding window before inspecting post-bid savings.
Open Master QCS as required by the case and confirm the comparison grid rendered.
Navigate to the Price Trends view where the savings result is shown.

args.goal: On Price Trends, verify that the savings for the CYLINDER product are calculated using the Last Purchase Price reference and that the displayed savings result is present; stop on the Price Trends screen with that evidence visible.

steps.note: Verify the final savings basis and calculated result, which no dedicated assertion step exposes.
